prompts.boy: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent sprite for a CHILD'S FELT-TIP DRAWING brought to life in an animation. Draw ONE small boy EXACTLY like a six-year-old drew him with chunky colored felt-tip pens on paper. Big simple round peach head, just five short crooked black strokes for hair, two small black dot eyes, one cheerful curved smile. Very simple orange block-shaped sweater, blue shorts, thin little arms and legs, chunky brown shoes. Both small hands held together in front of his chest, holding a tiny bright yellow five-point star. Full body, slight three-quarter pose facing right, occupies 85 percent of tall portrait canvas. Deliberately uneven thick marker outlines, flat bright color fills, visible overlapping marker strokes and a few little unfilled white spots. Charming, naive, childlike, playful, no sophistication. NO gradients, NO shading or volumetric light, NO realistic anatomy or facial detail, NO watercolor, NO pencil illustration, NO professional picture-book rendering, NO 3D. Genuine TRANSPARENT background around the figure, no ground scene, no lettering, no watermark.
